_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the source-file-size hard limit. Each entry needs an exact maxLines, a rationale, an owner, and a kind. Temporary debt (kind "other") also needs an issue or reviewBy date. See .pi/skills/aikami-conventions/SKILL.md. Remove exceptions as files shrink; the guard fails on obsolete entries.

packages/shared/constants/src/lib/countr.rationale: Cohesive ISO-3166 country/region table: one nested literal per country, consumed as a single lookup dataset. Splitting it would scatter one data structure across files without creating a responsibility boundary.

packages/shared/constants/src/lib/locale.rationale: Cohesive locale registry (one record per locale) consumed as a single lookup table. It is declarative data with no logic; file boundaries would add imports, not cohesion.

packages/shared/lpc/src/lib/legacy_catal.rationale: Generated legacy LPC catalog ordering snapshot (DO NOT hand-edit; regenerated from the test fixture and kept in parity by a test). A single frozen data structure that must not be split because legacy appearance indices depend on its exact order.

packages/shared/utils/src/lib/form/weak_.rationale: Cohesive static password blocklist (top 10000 common passwords, filtered). It is a single reference dataset with no logic; splitting adds imports without creating a responsibility boundary.

packages/backend/database/src/lib/schema.rationale: Cohesive declarative Drizzle schema for the repository database. C-530 adds the theme-slug ownership table beside the theme publishing tables and their foreign-key relationships; splitting the schema would scatter one relational model across modules without creating a responsibility boundary.

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/services/ga.rationale: One cohesive session-lifecycle service (sessions, recaps, checkpoint CRUD, fork, context compaction). A review-mandated compensating fork saga grew it 21 lines past its grandfathered baseline; the saga and its rollback belong with the checkpoint transitions it guards, so the growth is accepted rather than split across files.

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/views/dev/o.rationale: Fixture-driven design-sandbox ViewModel (Phase 1). It reached main at 809 lines via the #327 squash while the PR head measured 800; main's push-to-main guard run does not re-scan unchanged files, so the oversize surfaced only on the next apps-touching PR. Reviewed so this provenance PR can land; the sandbox is dev-only and slated for removal once the design is proven.

scripts/src/lib/agents/contract_pipeline.rationale: Grew on main in e8080d511 ("fix: contract pipeline"), which changed this file but did not re-run guard_source_file_size. Main's push-to-main run has an empty affected set, so it never re-scans and the oversize surfaced only on the next scripts-touching PR (C-511). Accepted so that PR can land. This is the pipeline's public surface: every exported stage entry point and its shared run context live here.

Grew on main in e8080d511 ("fix: contract pipeline"), which changed this file but did not re-run guard_source_file_size. Main's push-to-main run has an empty affected set, so it never re-scans and the oversize surfaced only on the next scripts-touching PR (C-511). Accepted so that PR can land. The stage state machine (planning -> implement -> verify -> review -> reconcile). All stages share one mutable run context and transition table, so splitting it would spread a single state machine across files without creating a boundary.

scripts/src/lib/herdr/session.ts.rationale: C-513: contract-ID resolution for a restored herdr pane. `CONTRACT_PIPELINE_CONTRACT_PATH` is injected per stage via `tab create --env`, but a pane restored after a daemon restart (or relaunched from the pane's shell) comes back without it, so `currentContractId()` fell back to undefined and `herdr_session`/`herdr:start` dropped dev services into the shared `aikami-emulator` workspace instead of the contract's own. The fix derives the id from the worktree path and keeps the env as the primary source. Grew 2279 -> 2299 on main in 76fdbbaf2, whose push-to-main run resolves 0 targets (`moon ci --base=origin/main` diffs main against itself), so this repo-wide guard never re-scanned it and the stale ceiling surfaced only on the next scripts-touching PR. Raises the reviewed ceiling, not the hard limit; owner review by the reviewBy date.

scripts/src/lib/herdr/worktree.ts.rationale: herdr worktree lifecycle (create/open/list/bootstrap/reconcile/publish/remove). The teardown half — owned-service and port cleanup plus the rmSync safety guard — moved to `worktree_teardown.ts`, which owns the one destructive path in the lifecycle and is now unit-testable on its own; the ceiling is LOWERED from 1323 to the post-split size. What remains is provisioning + publishing, which mutate one worktree registry and must stay ordered together.

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/services/ga.rationale: The overlay router: overlay stack, dialogue/vendor/management overlay transitions, save + auto-save scheduling and the combat entry/exit flow. C-525 R-5 moved its public contract (the service interface, the handler type and the start outcome) into `game_overlay_types.ts` so `startCombat` could return a TYPED rejection when the overlay refuses to open without hiding the new lines; behaviour is unchanged and the ceiling is LOWERED from 1491 to the post-split size (1340).

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/views/comba.rationale: C-516 direct control plus the C-525 R-2/R-4/R-7 remediation and the C-525 R-1 decomposition. R-1 extracted the two named responsibilities into focused modules: `combat_selection_controller.svelte.ts` (move/ability/target selection, preview round trips bound to the state revision, highlight projection) and `combat_intent_flow.svelte.ts` (the natural-language interpret → compile → preview → confirm loop). C-525 also wires the engine's resolved kernel events into outcome narration and gates the language surface to v2. What remains here is the composition of those controllers with the event-driven ViewModel lifecycle. The ceiling was raised from 2296 to 2500 to cover the current combat work; it must keep coming down as further responsibilities move out.

packages/frontend/engine/src/game_world..rationale: The main-thread `COMBAT_START_ENCOUNTER` forwarder registrations, the `COMBAT_MOVE_MODE` gate and lifecycle reset, the canvas move-intent bridge back to the selection owner, and the C-525 R-2 `COMBAT_SELECTION_HIGHLIGHTS` registration all still register here because the worker cannot see a UI selection and GameWorld is the single owner of bridge-command registration. C-525 R-1 moved the forwarder BODIES into `game_world/command_forwarding.ts` (behaviour identical — only the declaration site moved), so this ceiling is LOWERED from 2320 to the post-split size (2214).

packages/frontend/engine/src/systems/tur.rationale: +2: the legacy turn manager now stands down for an encounter pinned to the v2 resolver. The pin is read from the encounter, never from the feature flag, so a mid-fight config change cannot move an encounter between engines.

packages/frontend/engine/src/types.ts.rationale: +2 (C-495): `QuestData.awaitingEndingChoice`. Finishing a multi-ending quest's required objectives parks it at a resolution point instead of resolving it, and the quest overlay must present the ending choice only in that state — so the projection the HUD reads has to carry the flag. `QuestData` is the single QuestStateService → UI projection contract; the alternative (a service method plus a new ViewModel capability) moves the same two lines into `quest_state_service.svelte.ts` and adds surface. Ceiling raised 957 -> 959 (the field plus its one-line doc); no existing statement was minified to fit. Previous rationale, kept for context: +29: the C-516 wire additions — the `COMBAT_MOVE_MODE` and `COMBAT_START_REJECTED` commands, the `COMBAT_START_ENCOUNTER` envelope, and the additive `engine` / `playerEntityId` / `encounterId` / `stateRevision` event fields. This file is the single `GameCommand`/`GameEvent` union and the repo's documented home for cross-boundary wire types, so additives have nowhere else to go.

packages/frontend/engine/src/worker/ecs_.rationale: +129: the worker's `COMBAT_START_ENCOUNTER` handler (validation before any spawn, roster materialisation, engine pin, typed rejection plus legacy fallback), `COMBAT_MOVE`, `COMBAT_SYNC_REQUEST`, and engine-routed preview/action dispatch. The worker owns its own command switch, and the combat cases read the same world/state locals as the rest of it. Named follow-up: extract the combat cases into a combat worker module.

packages/shared/utils/src/lib/rules/comb.rationale: C-532: the combat kernel is the single transactional command-resolution pipeline — validate -> commit a movement prefix -> open/resolve a reaction window -> resume the suspended continuation -> run the ordered resolution pass (morale, objectives, settlement) -> apply. The command validation/normalization boundary is now extracted from this file into `combat_kernel_validation.ts` (the kernel keeps only a re-export of the public `validateCombatCommand`/`CombatCommandInput` facade and imports `validateMove` for the continuation resume), lowering the ceiling from 1481 to the post-split size. What remains is the ordered pipeline plus the reaction suspension/continuation: those functions share one `BatchAccumulator` and append to one ordered `CombatEvent[]` whose exact sequence is asserted by the C-509 event-sequence tests and replay determinism, so a further split would widen the public surface for a lower line count. Named follow-up: extract `combat_kernel_reactions.ts` (suspension/continuation) behind an internal module.

scripts/src/lib/agents/contract_pipeline.rationale: C-513: worker tool allowlists now resolve to literal tool names. `--tools` is a tool-name allowlist, but the adapter passed `resolveEnabledExtensions` keys (`herdr_orchestrator`, `contract_factory`), which were silently dropped — a worker could start without ever being able to call `contract_stage complete`. the fix imports `resolveEnabledTools` from `.pi/extensions/lib/role_profiles.ts`, which expands extension keys into their registered tool names. Grew 1539 -> 1545 on main in 76fdbbaf2; the guard never re-scanned it there (0 resolved targets on push-to-main). Converted from the grandfathered baseline entry to an exception because raising a baseline entry is rejected as unauthorized expansion against the base ref, which is the guard's documented remedy for exactly this diagnostic.

packages/shared/schemas/src/lib/game/con.rationale: +9: C-523 adds the manifest's optional, versioned `audio` section (`PackAudioBindingsSchema`) plus its import. `ContentPackManifestSchema` is not strict at the top level, so an authored `audio` field is already accepted by every reader — typing it is what turns a silently-ignored section into a validated one (the contract's explicit ordering: schema, then reader, then authored fields). This file is the single manifest schema and the repo's documented home for pack-level sections, so an additive optional section has nowhere else to go. Converted from the grandfathered baseline entry to a reviewed exception because raising a baseline entry is rejected as unauthorized expansion against the base ref, which is the guard's documented remedy for exactly this diagnostic.

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/services/ga.rationale: +6: C-523 must request a map's authored audio cue from the point where the map id is actually settled. The engine's MAP_LOADED fires from inside the world load, before `currentMapId` is assigned, so a cue requested from that listener resolves the PREVIOUS map's binding (observed live: the village cue stayed active after loading inn/merchant_shop/old_road/ruined_shrine). The announcement plus the cue request belong immediately after the assignment, in the same method that owns it. Converted from the grandfathered baseline entry to a reviewed exception because raising a baseline entry is rejected as unauthorized expansion against the base ref, which is the guard's documented remedy for exactly this diagnostic. Raised 1156 -> 1160 at publication: Biome's formatter (lineWidth 100) wraps the C-523 `audio_asset_resolver` import across four lines, so the extra 4 are the formatter's and carry no new prose or logic — the ceiling had been set against a copy of this file that did not pass `:format`. No statement was minified to avoid the change.

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/services/au.rationale: +52: C-523 needs a real BGM fade-to-silence for a declared authored silence. `stopAll()` also kills SFX and would break the music/ambient/SFX bus separation the contract requires, so `fadeOutBgm()` ramps only the BGM gain chain and clears the active track. The method reads the same private gain/source/abort fields as `transitionToBgm` and `pauseBgm`, so extracting it would expose those fields across a module boundary for no cohesion gain. Ceiling raised 800 -> 811 (the method plus its interface doc); owner review by the reviewBy date. Converted to a reviewed exception because a baseline entry cannot be raised against the base ref.

apps/frontend/client/src/lib/services/ga.rationale: +4: C-523 resets the audio arbitration authority on game/pack teardown, so a disposed session cannot leave a stale cue holding the authority or an in-flight transition racing the next boot. The one-line import plus the call in the existing `teardown()` are the whole change; the call belongs with the other teardown work that owns engine resources. Converted from the grandfathered baseline entry (1632) to a reviewed exception because raising a baseline entry is rejected as unauthorized expansion against the base ref, which is the guard's documented remedy for exactly this diagnostic.
